fullDescription: Classic SaaS marketing navbar: left wordmark, centered links, right pill CTA on a sticky white-glass header with a gradient announcement strip; emerald-on-white, Inter, AA-legible green CTA gradient, clean responsive reflow.

structured.summary: A classic SaaS marketing navbar in the proven left-wordmark / center-links / right-CTA arrangement, sitting on a sticky white glass header with a thin gradient announcement strip above it. Emerald-on-white palette, Inter type, a pill primary CTA with a legibility-tuned green gradient (white text clears 4.5:1 across the whole fill), and a tidy responsive reflow where links collapse into a hamburger and the CTA stays full-width.

style.description: Bright, trustworthy emerald-on-white SaaS aesthetic. Inter everywhere, tight tracking on headings, soft shadows tinted with the brand green, generous whitespace, fully rounded (pill) primary actions and rounded-xl logo tile. Restrained accent use: emerald carries the brand, slate ('ink') carries the text hierarchy.
style.prompt: Use a clean, modern SaaS visual language on a white background. Typeface: Inter (weights 400/500/600/700/800), antialiased, with tight (-tracking) headings. Color system, two scales: EMERALD accent - 50 #ecfdf5, 100 #d1fae5, 400 #34d399, 500 #10b981, 600 #059669, 700 #047857, 800 #065f46; INK/slate neutrals for text and borders - 50 #f8fafc, 100 #f1f5f9, 200 #e2e8f0, 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 700 #334155, 900 #0f172a. Body text ink-900, secondary text ink-500/700, hairline borders ink-100. Primary CTA is a fully-rounded pill filled with a top-to-bottom emerald gradient linear-gradient(180deg,#059669 0%,#058460 55%,#047857 100%) so white label text holds >=4.5:1 contrast across the whole fill; emerald-tinted soft drop shadow (shadow-emerald-600/25), lift 1px and deepen shadow on hover. Brand-tinted soft shadows, no harsh black shadows. Icons via a single line/bold icon set (Solar/Iconify) sized 16-22px.

layout_and_structure.description: Sticky header = two stacked bars: a thin centered announcement strip, then the main nav at 76px height. Main nav is a single flex row, space-between, inside a max-w-7xl centered container with px-5/px-8 gutters: wordmark hard-left, primary link group centered (hidden below lg), secondary 'Log in' text link + primary pill CTA + hamburger hard-right. Optional thin hero + full-bleed category rail can sit below for context.

prompts.prompt: Wrap everything in a sticky top-0 z-50 header. All inner content is centered in a mx-auto max-w-7xl container with px-5 (sm:px-8) horizontal padding.

Top bar: a thin full-width strip with a subtle emerald wash background (two faint radial-gradient glows top-left/top-right over a horizontal #ecfdf5 -> #f0fdf4 -> #ecfdf5 gradient), bottom border emerald-100. Centered row, py-2.5, 13-14px: a magic-stick icon (emerald-600) + 'New: <message>', a thin vertical divider, then a 'See what's new' emerald-700 link with a right-arrow icon. Hide the divider/link and the 'New:' label on the smallest breakpoint.
Below the strip, a nav with bg-white/85 + backdrop-blur-md and a bottom border ink-100. Inside the container, a flex row, h-[76px], items-center, justify-between, gap-6.

Left, shrink-0: a 36x36 rounded-xl emerald-500 tile with a soft emerald shadow holding a white palette icon, then the wordmark 'Prompt' (ink-900) + 'palette' (emerald-600) at 20px, font-extrabold, tight tracking.

Center (hidden lg:flex), gap-8, 15px medium ink-700 links: 'Library', 'Use cases', 'Showcase', 'Resources', 'Pricing'. Library/Use cases/Resources each get a small ink-400 down-chevron that rotates 180deg on hover. Each link has an animated emerald-500 underline that scales in from center on hover (the underline sits at the bottom edge of the nav bar).

Right, shrink-0, gap-2 (sm:gap-4): a 'Log in' secondary text link (15px semibold ink-700, hidden on the smallest breakpoint), then the primary pill CTA 'Start designing' with a trailing arrow-up-right icon, then a hamburger button (lg:hidden, 40x40 rounded-xl, ink-700, hover bg ink-50). On narrow widths the CTA stays full-size and 'Log in' moves into the hamburger menu so the primary button is never clipped.

special_ui_components.prompt: Pill primary CTA with a vertical emerald gradient fill tuned for >=4.5:1 white-text contrast across the whole button, emerald-tinted soft shadow, 1px hover lift
Animated center-out underline on nav links (scaleX 0->1, cubic-bezier ease) anchored to the bottom edge of the nav bar
Down-chevrons on dropdown nav items that rotate 180deg on group hover
Thin announcement strip with layered radial + linear emerald gradient wash
Sticky glass nav: bg-white/85 + backdrop-blur-md with hairline bottom border
Live status dot inside the hero pill that pulses (ping) like a finished build
Blinking 'ship caret' beside the headline accent word for product personality

structured.special_notes: Accessibility-tuned variant: the CTA fill is a 180deg gradient (#059669 -> #058460 -> #047857) specifically so white label text clears WCAG AA 4.5:1 over every part of the button, unlike a flat light-green fill. Keep the two-scale (emerald accent + ink/slate neutral) system intact, the 76px nav height, the max-w-7xl centered container, and the left/center/right three-zone arrangement; the underline + chevron-rotate micro-interactions are what make it feel finished. Hero strip and category rail are optional context below the navbar, not part of the navbar pattern itself.
